title: EMSD's inspections reveal serious deficiencies in lift replacement works undertaken by registered lift contractor at two estates
summary: ​In response to the recent allegations of non-compliance by Taizoom Elevator Company (HK) Limited (Taizoom), the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department (EMSD) takes the matter seriously and conducted surprise inspections on the lift works concerned. The inspections revealed serious deficiencies in lift replacement works carried out by Taizoom in two Tenants Purchase Scheme Estates, involving 9 lifts in Tsui Ping (North) Estate in Kwun Tong, of which the replacement was completed between February and July 2026, and 39 lifts in Pok Hong Estate in Sha Tin, of which the replacement was completed between May 2025 and July 2026. Regarding the fire resisting doorsets, including door frame components, although a fire resisting rating certificate was submitted, it was found that only the fire resisting doors were installed as required, but the corresponding door frame components were not installed, and the lift works were claimed to be completed. The absence of these door frame components in the lifts concerned is a non-compliance, but the lifts can still operate safely.
